Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Huckmon] in its name on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with [Huckmon] or [Jesmon] in its name, ＜Delay＞.
・You may play 1 card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
